OVERVIEW: llvm-dlltool

USAGE: llvm-dlltool [options] file...

OPTIONS:
  -D <value>              Specify the input DLL Name
  -d <value>              Input .def File
  -f <value>              Assembler Flags
  --identify-strict       Error out if the --identify option detects more than one DLL
  -I <value>              Identify DLL name from import library
  -k                      Kill @n Symbol from export
  -l <value>              Generate an import lib
  -m <value>              Set target machine
  --no-leading-underscore Don't add leading underscores on symbols
  -N <value>              Input native .def File on ARM64EC
  -S <value>              Assembler
  -t <value>              Prefix for temporary files (ignored)

TARGETS: i386, i386:x86-64, arm, arm64, arm64ec, r4000
